g.style: fill:#000000; fill-opacity:1.0000;stroke:#000000; stroke-opacity:1.0000; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;

g.text: USB 5 V in, isolated +/-12 V, no external supply

g.desc: USB 5 V in, isolated +/-12 V, no external supply

g.style: fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;

g.text: Flags (unlabelled) mark +5V, +12V and -12V as driven for ERC, since they sit behind FB1 / L1 / L2.

g.desc: Flags (unlabelled) mark +5V, +12V and -12V as driven for ERC, since they sit behind FB1 / L1 / L2.

g.text: No external power supply. Everything runs from the USB 5 V that the XIAO passes out on its 5V pin (sheet 4).

g.desc: No external power supply. Everything runs from the USB 5 V that the XIAO passes out on its 5V pin (sheet 4).

g.text: PS1 is a board-mounted isolated 2 W DC-DC module: 5 V in, +/-12 V 80 mA out. Unregulated: the rails follow USB voltage and load,

g.desc: PS1 is a board-mounted isolated 2 W DC-DC module: 5 V in, +/-12 V 80 mA out. Unregulated: the rails follow USB voltage and load,

g.text: about +/-11 V on a sagging port and up to +/-14 V at 5.25 V and light load; every part on the rails is rated for that (PGA2310 max 16 V).

g.desc: about +/-11 V on a sagging port and up to +/-14 V at 5.25 V and light load; every part on the rails is rated for that (PGA2310 max 16 V).

g.text: Budget at 5 V: XIAO ~30 mA, PS1 ~180 mA for 30 mA per rail, PGA logic 30 mA, LED 2 mA. ~250 mA typical, 320 mA worst case; USB 2.0 allows 500 mA.

g.desc: Budget at 5 V: XIAO ~30 mA, PS1 ~180 mA for 30 mA per rail, PGA logic 30 mA, LED 2 mA. ~250 mA typical, 320 mA worst case; USB 2.0 allows 500 mA.

g.text: All grounds meet once at PS1 Common. Keep PS1 at the far end of the board from J1 / J2. Total rail capacitance stays under the 220 uF the TBA 2 allows.

g.desc: All grounds meet once at PS1 Common. Keep PS1 at the far end of the board from J1 / J2. Total rail capacitance stays under the 220 uF the TBA 2 allows.
